context: Mei takes baby (use sho_child as small child) to first electronic toy demo.
purpose: Mother and child exploring new gadget play.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Bright, immediate wonder. Quick intake of breath before speaking. Warm, awed tone — the voice of a child discovering something magical for the first time. Slightly breathless with excitement.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Soft, delighted acknowledgment. Gently mirroring his wonder without overwhelming it. Warm, engaged — the tone of a mother savoring her child's discovery alongside him. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 楽しい、もっと触りたい!
lines.en: It's so fun — I want to touch it more!
lines.style: Pure eagerness breaking through. Quick, bouncing energy. The voice of a six-year-old who can barely contain himself. Warm but animated — not quite demanding, but close to it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Gentle but grounded. A soft note of caution without fear. Warm maternal tone — setting a boundary that feels like protection, not restriction. Easy and reassuring.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Quick, eager compliance. Small, warm voice — he's understood and wants to please. Responsive, almost echoing her kindness back at her. Genuine and unselfconscious.
